old_claims.statement: For each nonzero vector in a lower spectral band (0,mu] of A=dd_h^* on im d, ||eta||_0^2>=delta*exp(-b)*mu^(-1)*||eta||_h^2.
old_claims.attribution: Original compact manuscript spectral.tex:467-478; expanded by old Argus proof.md Section 4.
old_claims.supported_scope: Nonzero bounded lower spectral bands of the closed-range restricted operator; no point-spectrum assumption.

hypotheses: An exact closed-range Hilbert complex and its common unweighted gap delta>0.
1<=h<=B=exp(b), b finite, with equality of differential-domain sets under norm equivalence.
q>=1, mu>0 and nonzero eta in the spectral subspace (0,mu] of A on B_q=im d_(q-1).
supported_scope: The unweighted primitive is an admissible weighted differential-domain lift.
The weighted minimal lift has norm squared <A^(-1)eta,eta>_h and is bounded below on the band by ||eta||_h^2/mu.
Minimality and the coarse lift bound give the claimed inequality without using the improved Bochner estimate.
limitations: No inequality for an arbitrary empty-band cutoff is asserted.
The comparison does not follow from a finite toy matrix without the actual complex assumptions.
No equality of adjoint domains or Lean formalization of spectral calculus is supplied.

prior_review_reconciliation.interpretation: Historical same-subject support does not erase the current independent-review requirement.

decisive_checks: The coarse inverse is established before using A^(-1).
A^(-1)=V^*V on the closed target range and lambda<=mu implies 1/lambda>=1/mu.
The inequality chain is mu^(-1)*||eta||_h^2<=||V eta||_h^2<=B/delta*||eta||_0^2.
